final_message:
I reviewed all 47 disbursement lines on the HWK May 2025 invoice against the billing guidelines, the engagement letter and the pre-approval log. I recommend $42,822.30 in reductions, leaving $102,582.00 allowable, plus another $192.50 held until HWK supplies documentation. The invoice totals are also wrong: the disbursement lines add up to $145,404.30, not the stated $86,742.19, and the fee lines add up to $161,698.50, not $187,420. Because the reductions exceed $25,000, the General Counsel (Lorraine Cha) has to approve them under guideline §8.2(b).
